items.name: CSI FPC/FFC camera cable
procurement_hold: Do not release based only on15Pfilename. Verify both ends pitch,thickness,insertion length,contact-side same/opposite and pin1mapping.
200mm is user-selected length,not verified electrical/high-frame-rate or mechanical bend/strain-relief compatibility.
